# unifi_network_radius_account (Resource)

A UniFi RADIUS user account (`account`, legacy `/rest`) — a username/password served by the gateway's built-in RADIUS server, optionally carrying dynamic-VLAN tunnel attributes. Reference it from a `unifi_network_radius_profile` that has `use_usg_auth_server = true`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) RADIUS username.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) RADIUS password (`x_password`). Write-only: the controller does not echo it back, so the configured value is preserved in state.

### Optional

- `tunnel_medium_type` (Number) RADIUS Tunnel-Medium-Type attribute (e.g. `6` = IEEE-802).
- `tunnel_type` (Number) RADIUS Tunnel-Type attribute for dynamic VLAN assignment (e.g. `13` = VLAN). Set together with `tunnel_medium_type` and `vlan`.
- `vlan` (Number) Tunnel-Private-Group-ID — the VLAN id assigned to clients authenticating as this user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
